items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I started organizing my combos... Boyd Millett playing piano at that time.

ctx.x: I started organizing my combos. I was working down in the old district down there at uh, 225 with David Jones. Well it was Elric Kuyfer on trumpet. And uh, Boyd Millett playing piano at that time. Henry Russell.
